what: The declared real-at-basis ladder: the matched-basis ladder's same state space (1296 ordered types, the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides), the same four declared rungs, the same member bands re-priced per rung, and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries, with the real's own kept-adjacent pair sequence re-priced at each rung beside them: its first basis - 1 pairs, the exact full-width mass every one of the rung's cut rows prices, through the same mark-excluded block. The anchor rung's comparison is the matched-basis ladder's own; every descended rung's comparison is mass-matched on both sides for the first time in this family. The declared truthful question: does the real's own descending profile track the rung bands' descension or stay apart down the ladder in every (file, language) cell. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, the mark located in each matrix's own alphabet, and the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side while the simulated alphabets are saturated at 36 in every cell)
declared.real_ladder_rule: the real's own kept-adjacent pair sequence re-priced at the matched-basis ladder's declared rungs, recorded as design before any pricing: the anchor rung first at the cell's real counted pair total + 1 tokens (ZL 218,416, GC 183,200, IT 220,532), then floor(p x the anchor basis) rungs at p 0.75, 0.50 and 0.25 (ZL 163,812, 109,208 and 54,604; GC 137,400, 91,600 and 45,800; IT 165,399, 110,266 and 55,133); at every rung the real prices its first basis - 1 kept-adjacent pairs through the same mark-excluded block and the same six summaries, and the real's cut can move its own profile both ways exactly as a band's cut moves a band's closed ranges both ways; the anchor rung's re-priced profile is the real's unchanged matched-basis ladder profile exactly and every descended rung's is fresh
declared.mass_rule: the comparison at every rung is mass-matched on the paired side by the exact band arithmetic the matched-basis ladder priced, and mass-matched on the real side by construction: the real's rung mass is its rung basis - 1 pairs and every one of the rung's cut rows prices its match_basis_events - 1 pairs full width, the mass-match identity verified against the frozen rung's rows before any envelope is formed; a rung's whole rows keep their standing masses inside the envelope, the same disclosed mix the anchor rung carried, and the real's re-priced block total equals the mass minus its own boundary-carried pairs exactly
declared.band_reference_rule: the rung bands are the frozen matched-basis ladder's rung facts taken by reference, their own measurements verified under that instrument's gate and tests: the anchor rung's envelope result is re-derived fresh here and verified equal to the frozen anchor rung's, and every descended rung's envelope runs the real's fresh re-priced profile against the frozen rung's member profiles exactly as that instrument stored them
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and no encoding is re-run on the band side anywhere: the bands are the frozen instrument's own

invariants.sorted_symbol_marginals: the 36 mark-excluded glyph marginals as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position over 36 positions
invariants.sorted_pair_multiset: the 1296 mark-excluded pair counts as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.empty_type_count: the number of the block's mark-excluded pair types with zero counted occurrences, a scalar inside [min, max]
invariants.self_pair_share: the block's diagonal sum over the profile's glyph-pair total
invariants.top_k_shares: the share of the glyph-pair total carried by the k largest pair counts, at k 1, 10 and 50
invariants.pair_entropy: the natural entropy of the mark-excluded pair distribution in nats per counted glyph pair

declared.state_note: every band profile here is the frozen matched-basis ladder's mark-excluded member profile at its rung width, taken by reference; the real's profiles are priced fresh at every rung from its own ordered kept-adjacent pair sequence, whose adjacency is the original stream's with the unmapped events breaking it (126 unmapped events inside ZL's 218,663, 1,769 inside GC's 186,708, none inside IT's 220,532) exactly as disclosed since the interior instrument; the anchor rung's real profile is the whole sequence and equals the frozen profile the gate verifies; the share-valued invariants normalise by their own glyph-pair totals, so the real's descending mass prices like the bands' descending masses at every rung
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags; the standing budgets are not applicable and no machinery recording appears for that reason
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its stream after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.seed_kinds: no seed is consumed anywhere in this instrument: the real's own sequence needs no encoding, the bands are the frozen instrument's facts taken by reference, and the standing plant encodings replay their frozen declared draws on the real-record side only, the same standing encodings every predecessor priced
declared.record_rule: per cell the artifact records the real record once (verified against the frozen matched-basis ladder record) and the four declared rungs in order (the anchor rung first, then 75, 50 and 25 percent), each rung carrying its run percentage, its basis, the real's rung mass, the rung's boundary-carried pairs, the real's re-priced profile, its envelope tests, its outside list and its verdict; the rung's member band itself is not re-stored here: it stays the frozen instrument's declared record
declared.verdict_rule: declared strict-all, unchanged, priced per rung on the real's re-priced profile: a rung-cell is shape-consistent-with-homophonic-encoding only when every declared invariant of the real's re-priced glyph-block profile sits inside the closed range of that rung's matched band's glyph-block profiles (the two vector summaries term by term inside the band's per-position envelope over 36 sorted positions, the scalar summaries inside [min, max] at the stored 6-decimal rounding); any outside invariant makes the rung-cell shape-outside-analogues, every outside entry is recorded with its band range so the miss is audited not summarized, and the declared question is asked over all 24 rung-cell verdicts together
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is inside or outside per invariant per rung, and the recorded distances are the outside entries' band ranges themselves
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.bridge_gate_rule: before any rung is priced, the gate verified fresh in two stages: the matched-basis ladder's gate exactly as that instrument declared it (the matched-truncation instrument's 540 anchor and replay fields plus the 117 anchor-rung replay checks, 657 fields), then per cell the fresh real record verified against the frozen matched-basis ladder's cell record (its eight declared fields), the four rung bases' identities, and the anchor rung's fresh envelope equal to the frozen anchor rung's envelope result, 6 checks per cell, 36 checks total, 693 fields compared; the three descended rungs' envelopes carry no frozen counterpart and ride on the declared rung rule, whose mass-match identity aborts on any divergence; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
